26.original: Deliver the veggie sack to Pawkwena.

48.original: I'm not sure what you're doing here, but I certainly won't look a gift rroneek in the mouth. Could you go and fetch me a vegetable?

49.original: Er...I should probably explain. I'm trying to plan out my dinner tonight, but for the life of me, I just can't decide what to make!

50.original: It won't be much trouble, I promise you. Go to Yyupye's Halo and speak to Shepimenye─he's bound to have a few seasonal offerings.

51.original: Go to Yyupye's Halo and speak to Shepimenye. He'll have something fresh to offer, I'm sure of it.

52.original: Aren't you the guest who was touring the farm with Queen Sphene? Is there something I can assist you with?

53.original: Ah, so Pawkwena sent you to get produce. You'll certainly find no shortage of that here.

54.original: This time of year, we have glassgem corn, Turali pumpkins, and sweet popotoes. Take your pick.

55.original: You may freely choose between glassgem corn, Turali pumpkins, and sweet popotoes. Knowing Pawkwena, she can cook a delectable dish with any of them.

56.original: Plump kernels of corn peek out from within the dried husks.

58.original: Corn is a highly versatile vegetable. I'll bag it up for you─here.

59.original: The brightly colored pumpkins are heavy with pulp and seeds.

61.original: This year's pumpkin harvest has been especially flavorful. I'll bag it up for you─here.

62.original: Judging from the sheer size, these tubers are sure to be filling.

64.original: Sweet popotoes are one of my all-time favorites. I'll bag it up for you─here.

65.original: When it comes to produce, freshness is key. You should take it to Pawkwena without delay.

66.original: Welcome back! Did you pick me out something tasty?

67.original: Thank you! Yes, I think I'll bake up some hearty cornbread and serve it with butter.

68.original: Perfect! I should have all the ingredients for a light and sweet pumpkin soup.

69.original: Excellent! Looks like baked sweet popotoes are on the menu.

70.original: It's a traditional Yyasulani dish that's been passed down for generations. Even now it's fairly popular.

71.original: Made with our freshly grown vegetables, I feel closer to nature with every bite─something you won't experience with the food produced in Everkeep.

72.original: Anyway, thanks for humoring me. Here, take this─you don't mind ready-made, do you?
